title: The WP Ultimate CSV Importer WordPress plugin before 9.3 does not escape values from imported files before using them…
description: The WP Ultimate CSV Importer WordPress plugin versions before 9.3 contain a vulnerability where values from imported files are not escaped before use in SQL queries when importing LifterLMS content. This flaw allows high privilege users, such as administrators on single or multisite WordPress installations, to perform SQL injection attacks.
